Metadata.title: BridgLabs — Bruno Pinheiro, Software Engineer & Founder
Metadata.description: Bruno Pinheiro's career and shipped products, from problem to launch.

hero.name: BRUNO PINHEIRO
hero.photoAlt: Bruno Pinheiro in front of the Golden Gate Bridge
hero.title: I build products — at work and beyond it.
hero.description: For more than 10 years, I have turned complex requirements into experiences used by millions. At BridgLabs, I take problems that bother me from zero to a live product.

founder.description: BridgLabs is the main thread of this story: my independent lab for finding problems, shaping a thesis, designing, building, launching, and operating my own products.
founder.projectsHeading: PRODUCTS I TOOK FROM ZERO TO LIVE

pemuli.description: A sleep, feeding, and diaper log for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch — designed for real care, with one hand and little attention to spare.
pemuli.decision: I cut the product to sleep, feeding, and diapers and reserved the paywall for inviting another caregiver — logging and reviewing care stay free.
pemuli.delivery: A trilingual native MVP with per-child history, family sync, Watch, widgets, and Live Activities — implemented, but still awaiting release validation.

jobsSearch.description: An international remote-jobs portal for technology professionals in Brazil. The list — not a landing page — is the first screen.
jobsSearch.decision: I made acquisition and activation happen on the same screen: the top 10 is public; sign-in only appears when someone opens a job.
jobsSearch.delivery: A full catalog with search and filters, fed by a nightly pipeline that classifies, enriches, and publishes each snapshot atomically.

pinubi.description: Creators organize place recommendations on a searchable public page; followers go from the link in bio straight to the list, map, post, or route.
pinubi.decision: I removed the app and account requirement for followers and treated clicks as observable signals — never as visits, conversions, or revenue.
pinubi.delivery: A creator-first page with search, filters, list, and map; the aggregate dashboard shows demand, places, and posts that lead to content or route opens.

destrua.description: Two landing pages enter a live battle; AI compares, critiques, and picks the winner, with a social image generated for every match.
destrua.decision: I replaced the technical report with a public, shareable experience: humor, scorecards, and a winner make the analysis clear in seconds.
destrua.delivery: Persistent roasts and battles with criterion-by-criterion critiques, rankings, votes, links, and a social image for every result.

blueRiver.company: SparkAI → Blue River Technology · John Deere
blueRiver.description: I joined SparkAI to build human-in-the-loop products. After the acquisition, I moved into leading delivery and frontend systems for AI operations at Blue River.
blueRiver.proof: I built interfaces and workflows for human-in-the-loop operations that help computer-vision models reach and stay in production, as part of the team behind John Deere autonomous machinery and See & Spray.

gavea.role: Senior Software Engineer · Frontend Tech Lead
gavea.description: I led web, desktop, and mobile architecture for a blockchain-based digital commodities exchange.
gavea.proof: I unified the web, desktop, and mobile foundations and introduced CI/CD and automated testing, making the evolution of a blockchain trading platform more predictable.

globo.description: I built sports, education, and media experiences for one of Latin America's largest communication companies.
globo.proof: I shipped sports-prediction and ENEM exam-grading experiences used by millions of people during major audience moments.

b3.description: I helped modernize a legacy platform and worked full stack, with a stronger focus on frontend and testing, for critical capital-markets software.
b3.proof: I helped rebuild the Ibovespa rebalancing system on a modern, testable architecture, making a critical market workflow safer to evolve.

oxxy.description: I started as a full-stack engineer, maintaining legacy systems and automating repetitive operational processes across several business domains.
oxxy.proof: I automated manual routines and shipped end-to-end systems across automotive services, electronic traffic fines, driving schools, and condominium management.

closing.title: More than ten years later, the motivation is still the same.
closing.description: Understand a real problem and build something that deserves to exist.

footer.note: Designed and built by Bruno Pinheiro.
